title: Record the six-window connector gate bill
body:
## Summary
- Six chained write windows have hitting number 3, so even connector restoration uses four source calls.
- The scalar gate counts are 70 for the overlap, 84 for disjoint windows, and 126 for separately closed windows.
- The overlap saves fourteen gates, exactly two source calls. No new kappa, and the 5,336-case census is not rerun.
